title: Accounted for: pkix-chain's _verifier_is_send_sync mutant is unobservable
description:
## Why

The survivor cargo-mutants reports for pkix-chain that no test can kill.

    pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:2198:9  replace _verifier_is_send_sync with ()

`_verifier_is_send_sync` is a function inside a `const` block whose body is
`_assert_send_sync::<Verifier<'a, V, R, A>>()`. It is never called at
runtime; its job is to fail the build if `Verifier` stops being `Sync`, and
the build still fails in that case whether or not the body is replaced --
the mutation removes the assertion, and nothing a test can observe changes.

## Decision

Accounted for, not fixable. Recorded so the next sweep of this crate reads
16 survivors closed and one explained, rather than one unexplained.

The obligation itself is discharged by compilation, which is the point of
writing it that way.
